claims.short_name: Every even pair of degree caps can split any suitably bounded graph
claims.claim_text: For all positive even alpha,beta, every finite simple graph with maximum degree at most alpha+beta has an edge red/blue split with red maximum degree at most alpha and blue at most beta.
claims.support_summary: Classical explicit proof: augment to D-regular multigraph with loops permitted, Euler-orient in=out=D/2, decompose the corresponding D/2-regular bipartite multigraph into perfect matchings by Hall, pull back 2-factors and erase fake edges. Not asserted novel or fully Lean-checked.

claims.short_name: General odd-leading sharp-residual transfer and four infinite original size-Ramsey families
claims.claim_text: If both leading star sizes n1,m1 are odd >=3 and every arbitrary simple host satisfying both residual Ramsey relations has >=J=W-(n1+m1-1) edges, then the original size Ramsey number equals W. As corollaries of already proved paper-level residual cases: B1 n=(a,1,1),m=(b,c,1^(t-2)), odd a,b, 1<=c<=a, b>=a+c-1,t>=4: rhat=3b+(t-2)a+1; B2 n=(a,1^(s-1)),m=(a,1^(t-1)), odd a>=3,s,t>=3: rhat=(max(s,t)+1)a+min(s,t)-2; B3 n=(a,2,1),m=(a,1,1,1), odd a>=5: rhat=5a+3; B4 n=(a,1,1),m=(b,a-1,2,1), odd a,b>=3,b>=2a-2: rhat=3b+2a+2. Global conjecture OPEN.
claims.support_summary: For any original-arrowing G, every G-v arrows both residual pairs; sharp joint bound forces Delta(G)<=n1+m1-2 when e(G)<W. Even leading-degree caps alpha=n1-1,beta=m1-1 are positive even, so the protected classical regular-multigraph factorization theorem gives an avoiding red/blue capped split. The canonical antidiagonal host supplies upper W. Previously protected all-host joint residual proofs for families C1,C2, equal-leading (a,2,1), and profile mismatch yield four infinite original formulas; source script independently recomputes both antidiagonal index conventions over bounded grids. No global arbitrary-host residual result assumed as proved.
